title: Energizing Peppery Australian Potato Bao
description: A refreshing and invigorating breakfast dish featuring potato buns, coconut cream, and a variety of spices.
instructions: Steam the potato buns for 10 minutes to make them soft and fluffy.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Add the minced ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped chili and cook for 1 minute until slightly softened.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook for 2 minutes until slightly wilted.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked potato buns, coconut cream, and spices. Mix well until combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 15 minutes until golden brown.
Serve warm and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
